```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(hapmapsnp6)
```

# What this package provides

`hapmapsnp6` distributes a small sample of HapMap data generated on the
Affymetrix Genome-Wide Human SNP Array 6.0. It exists so that other
Bioconductor packages have a realistic dataset to demonstrate on, and it is
not meant for analysis in its own right.

Four resources are provided. Three are the raw CEL files for the HapMap
samples NA06985, NA06991 and NA06993. The fourth, `crlmmResult`, is the
genotype calling result obtained from those three files.

# Where the data lives

As of version 1.55.1 the data is no longer shipped inside the package.
It is deposited on Zenodo, under the DOI
[10.5281/zenodo.23990454](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23990454),
and served through `r Biocpkg("ExperimentHub")`.

The first call to any accessor downloads the resource and stores it in the
local ExperimentHub cache. Later calls read from that cache, so the download
cost is paid once per machine.

The chunks below query ExperimentHub and therefore need network access the
first time they run. The resources are registered under the identifiers
`EH10670` to `EH10673`. Once they are in the local cache, the vignette builds
without further downloads.

# Accessing the genotype calls

Earlier versions of this package shipped the object in `data/`, so it was
loaded with `data(crlmmResult)`. That call no longer works, because the
package ships no data directory. The accessor replaces it:

```{r accessor}
library(hapmapsnp6)
crlmmResult <- crlmmResult()
class(crlmmResult)
```

Resource metadata can be inspected without downloading the object, which is
useful in examples and tests that must not depend on the network:

```{r metadata}
crlmmResult(metadata = TRUE)
```

# Accessing the CEL files

`celFiles()` returns the paths of the three CEL files on disk, named after
the original files:

```{r cels}
cels <- celFiles()
basename(cels)
```

Code written against earlier versions of this package located the files with
`system.file("celFiles", package = "hapmapsnp6")`. That call cannot work for
files which are no longer installed with the package. The closest equivalent
returns a directory holding the three files:

```{r celdir}
dir <- celFiles(asDir = TRUE)
list.files(dir)
```

# Listing every resource

All resources carried by this package can be listed through ExperimentHub:

```{r listing}
library(ExperimentHub)
listResources(ExperimentHub(), "hapmapsnp6")
```

# Provenance and citation

The origin of the data and the processing that produced `crlmmResult` are
documented in `inst/scripts/make-data.R`. The International HapMap Project
invested considerable effort in generating these data; please cite it, as
recorded in `inst/CITATION`.

```{r citation}
citation("hapmapsnp6")
```
